title: Stop customer leakage across an evaluation split
description: Repair a deterministic train/test splitter that leaks customer entities across the evaluation boundary.

checks.test_entities_never_cross_the_boundary: No entity appears in both training and test data
checks.test_fraction_is_the_closest_complete_gr: The split uses the closest attainable complete-group test size
checks.test_seed_can_change_selected_entities: The seed can change which entities are selected
checks.test_input_is_not_mutated: The splitter does not mutate its input
checks.test_missing_entity_id_fails_clearly: Rows without entity identifiers fail clearly
